stem.text: The statements list some of the events in the cardiac cycle. They are not in the correct order.

items: The impulse travels through Purkyne tissue.
A wave of excitation sweeps across the atria.
The atrioventricular node delays the impulse for a fraction of a second.
The wave of excitation sweeps upwards from the base of the ventricles.
